chatbot-headline-text: Headline text displayed for the chatbot section.
chatbot-input-placeholder: Placeholder text inside the message input field, prompting the user to type a message.
chatbot-send-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Send' button to send a message.
chatbot-export-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Export chat' button to export chat history.
chatbot-export-popup-title: Title of the export popup window.
chatbot-export-popup-export-button: Button label for exporting chat in the popup.
chatbot-export-popup-cancel-button: Button label for canceling the export action in the popup.
chatbot-export-popup-format-label: Label for selecting the format in the export popup.
chatbot-export-error: Error message shown when there is nothing to export.
chatbot-resize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Resize chat' button, used to resize the chat window.
chatbot-maximize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Maximize chat' button, used to enlarge the chat window.
chatbot-minimize-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Minimize chat' button, used to reduce the chat window size.
chatbot-close-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Close chat' button, which also deletes chat history.
chatbot-copy-button-title: Tooltip text for the 'Copy answer' button, used to copy the chatbot's response.
chatbot-banner-help-button: Button text to navigate to the FAQ section.
chatbot-banner-close-button: Button text to close the information banner displayed in the chat.
chatbot-restore-session-text: Text offering the option to restore the previous session.
chatbot-reference-list-button: Button text for showing references related to the chatbot's response.
chatbot-answer-processing: Message displayed when the chatbot is processing the user's question.
chatbot-greeting: Initial greeting message shown when the chat starts.
chatbot-api-error:
Error message shown when there is an issue loading the chatbot, with $1 representing a dynamic error message.

Parameters:
* $1 - Error message
chatbot-api-load-error: Error message shown when there is an issue connecting to the chatbot
chatbot-api-stream-error: Error message shown when streaming is not supported on the server.
chatbot-missing-config: Error message shown when chatbot configuration is missing.
chatbot-pdf-title: Title for exported PDF, describing the content as an AI-generated answer from the chatbot.
chatbot-pdf-banner-text: Disclaimer banner text in the exported PDF, noting that the answer is AI-generated and may contain errors.
chatbot-api-references-not-found-error:
Error message when references cannot be found, with $1 as a placeholder for specific reference details.

Parameters:
* $1 - Reference id
chatbot-banner-label: Label indicating that the chatbot responses are AI-based and not from live personnel.
chatbot-close-popup-info-label: Information in a popup that closing the chat will delete the current conversation.
chatbot-close-popup-close-and-export-btn: Button text for exporting and then closing the chat.
chatbot-close-popup-close-btn-label: Button text for just closing the chat.
chatbot-close-popup-cancel-btn-label: Button text to cancel closing the chat.
chatbot-close-popup-header: Header title for the popup that confirms closing the chatbot.
chatbot-dismiss-error-button-title: Tooltip text for dismissing or closing an error message.
chatbot-copy-to-clipboard: Message shown after successfully copying an answer to the clipboard.
chatbot-attachments-popup-header: Header for a popup showing attachments related to the response.
chatbot-reference-attachments: Button text to display attachments in relation to a response.
chatbot-all-documents-popup-header: Header for a popup listing found sources or references.
chatbot-footer-disclaimer: Disclaimer text displayed in the chat footer.
chatbot-size-popup-title: Title of resize popup to change size of chatbot window
chatbot-size-large-button-title: Title for button to select fullsize of chatbot window
chatbot-size-medium-button-title: Title for button to select split view of chatbot window
chatbot-size-small-button-title: Title for button to select small size of chatbot window
chatbot-search-ai-result-summary-label: Header label for AI summary section
chatbot-search-ai-result-expand-btn-labe: Button label to expand long AI summary version
chatbot-restore-error: Error when session cannot be restored
chatbot-connection-error: Generic error on WebSocket connection error
chatbot-connection-error-final: Error message when no connection to server can be established, and will not try again
chatbot-save-page-button-title: Title for button to save answer as wikipage
chatbot-save-page-saved-label: Label for message that chat answer is saved as wikipage
chatbot-save-page-resources-label: Text for resources section when message is copied
chatbot-api-error-topic-api-label: Error label if chat api cannot create topic for message
chatbot-search-ai-result-resources-label: Label for resources section for search result
chatbot-config-name-help: Help text for input field to set name of chatbot
chatbot-instance-status-token-limit: Field label for InstanceStatus page showing token limit
chatbot-instance-status-unlimited: Field value for InstanceStatus page showing unlimited tokens
chatbot-instance-status-limit-reached: Warning message when token limit is reached
chatbot-instance-status-days-until-reset:
Message showing then the token limit will reset.
$1 - number of days
chatbot-external-error-token-limit-reach: Error message when token limit is reached
chatbot-config-enable-search-summary-lab: Label for checkbox to enable AI generated search summary
chatbot-config-enable-search-summary-hel: Help text for checkbox to enable AI generated search summary
